Research Technician Endometrial Biology and Gynaecological Cancer Research
  
  

Welcome to Maastricht University!
  
  

Help us better understand endometrial physiology, diseases and cancer, and contribute to new treatment strategies.
  
  

Are you an enthusiastic research technician with an educational background in biomedical sciences, molecular biology, biotechnology, life sciences or a related field? Do you enjoy working with advanced laboratory models and collaborating with researchers and clinicians from different disciplines? Then we would like to hear from you.
  
  

Research Technician – Endometrial Biology and Gynecological Cancer Research
  
  

**Our goal:** You will join our translational research team, which investigates endometrial biology and Gynaecological diseases, with a particular focus on endometrial cancer. Our research focuses on the role of steroid hormones in gynaecological diseases, including the therapeutic potential of hormonal treatments, mechanisms of treatment resistance and the identification of new therapeutic targets and drug combinations. To address these questions, we combine advanced in vitro and in vivo models with analyses of patient\-derived materials.
  
  

**Your colleagues:** a research team consisting of a principal investigator, senior scientists, research technicians, PhD candidates and undergraduate and master's students. We work closely with researchers from different disciplines and with clinical partners.
  
  

Our translational research environment brings together clinicians, molecular biologists, bioinformaticians, data scientists and bioengineers. You will also have the opportunity to interact with national and international research collaborators.
  
  

Our research environment provides access to a wide range of advanced facilities and technologies, including:
  
* animal facilities and in vivo imaging platforms, including CT, PET\-CT and bioluminescence imaging;
* advanced organoid and cell culture facilities;
* facilities for working with transgenic materials;
* advanced microscopy, including confocal, electron and two\-photon microscopy;
* genomic and transcriptomic technologies, including bulk, single\-cell and spatial analyses;
* mass spectrometry and mass spectrometry imaging;
* flow cytometry.


This gives you the opportunity to work with a broad range of techniques and to further develop your technical and scientific skills.
  
  

What you do
  
  

As a Research Technician, you will contribute to several ongoing research projects. You will work closely with PhD candidates, postdoctoral researchers, senior scientists and clinicians in a collaborative and multidisciplinary environment.
  
  

**Your main responsibilities include:**  

establishing, maintaining and characterising patient\-derived organoid models of endometrial tissue and endometrial cancer;
  
supporting research into steroid hormone metabolism in healthy and malignant endometrial tissues;
  
assisting with the development, maintenance and experimental use of mouse models for endometrial cancer;
  
performing molecular and cellular biology techniques, including RNA and DNA isolation, qPCR, protein analyses, immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence and tissue processing;
  
collecting, processing and managing patient\-derived samples and biobank materials;
  
supporting the day\-to\-day organisation and operation of the laboratory.
  
  

Depending on your experience and interests, you may also have the opportunity to develop your expertise in new techniques and contribute to different projects within the research.
  
  

Are you ready to set the course for the years ahead? Then we’d love to meet you.
  
  

What you bring
  
We are looking for a motivated and curious colleague who is enthusiastic about biomedical research and enjoys working in a multidisciplinary team.
  
  

**You have:**  

a completed HBO or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent training, in Biomedical Sciences, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline;
  
experience with cell culture and basic molecular biology techniques;
  
good communication skills in English and teamwork skills;
  
the ability to work independently and take responsibility for your work;
  
a proactive and flexible attitude;
  
an interest in contributing to translational cancer research.
  
  

**It would be an advantage if you also have:**  

* experience with three\-dimensional culture systems, such as organoids or spheroids;
* experience with animal experimentation and mouse handling;
* experience with histological or imaging techniques;
* an interest in endocrinology and gynaecological oncology.


You do not need to meet every preferred qualification. If you are motivated to learn and develop your skills, we encourage you to apply.
  
  

What we offer
  
At Maastricht University, you’ll work in an international, open, and engaged environment. We offer:
  
  

A 12\-month contract (0,4 fte) with the prospect of a permanent contract based on mutual satisfaction.
  
A gross monthly salary between €3537,00 and €4673,00 (based on full\-time employment of 38 hours per week). 8% holiday allowance and an 8\.3% year\-end bonus.
  
29 vacation days (based on full\-time), four additional days off (Carnival Monday and Tuesday, Good Friday, and Liberation Day), and the possibility to accrue up to 12 extra days through compensation hours.
  
Flexible working hours, a home office allowance, and the option to work from home.
  
Freedom and space to shape your work independently and develop your ideas.
  
A close\-knit community of colleagues to collaborate and grow with.
  
A solid pension plan via ABP, company fitness schemes, and access to various university sports facilities.
  
An inspiring work environment in the heart of Europe.
  
  

About the Faculty of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (FHML)
  
**FHML is committed to health in the broadest sense:** from molecule to human, and from healthcare to prevention. We train healthcare professionals and researchers through innovative educational programmes and conduct groundbreaking research in health and well\-being. As part of Maastricht UMC\+ (MUMC\+), our international and interdisciplinary community forms a unique collaboration between university and academic hospital, where education, research, and care come together.
  
  

Interested?
  
Want to know more about this position or what it’s like to work at our university? Reach out to Dr. Andrea Romano via a.romano@maastrichtuniversity.nl. The end date of the publication is 17 september. Interviews will be held shortly after.
  
  

Apply now via the button below. We look forward to getting to know you!
  
  

About Maastricht University
  
At Maastricht University, we collaboratively seek solutions to help move the world forward. We do this with 23,300 students and 5,400 employees across 5 regional locations, 6 faculties, and more than 70 research institutes. We encourage you to push boundaries and discover new opportunities for yourself and the world around you. Together, we can find the answers for tomorrow.
  
  

The vacancy is open for internal and external candidates. In case of equal qualifications, internal candidates will be prioritized.
  
  

At Maastricht University, we prefer to contact potential candidates directly. We therefore kindly ask that no agencies or intermediaries submit offers or approaches.
  
  

Maastricht University is committed to promoting and nurturing a diverse and inclusive community. We believe that diversity in our staff and student population contributes to the quality of research and education at UM, and strive to enable this through inclusive policies and innovative projects led by teams of staff and students. We encourage you to apply for this position.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat cateringbedrijven precies genoeg maaltijden bereiden zonder onnodige verspilling? Hoe optimaliseer je een logistiek netwerk zodat vrachtwagens minder kilometers rijden en toch alles op tijd leveren? Hoe maak je bedrijven AI ready door het bouwen van een stevig datafundament? Als Junior Data Engineer bij Incentro werk je aan dit soort uitdagende vraagstukken en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf razendsnel te ontwikkelen.


Heb jij een passie voor data, vind je het leuk om met Python en SQL te werken en wil je jezelf ontwikkelen tot een sterke Data Engineer? Dan is dit jouw kans om samen met ons datagedreven verandering te realiseren.

**Dit is hoe jij impact maakt**
-------------------------------


Als Junior Data Engineer bij Incentro werk je mee aan state\-of\-the\-art data\-infrastructuren die bedrijven helpen om slimmer te opereren en hun processen te optimaliseren. Onze klanten verwerken enorme hoeveelheden data, maar zonder de juiste infrastructuur blijven kansen onbenut. Samen met je collega's zorg jij ervoor dat data betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en bruikbaar wordt.


Wat dit concreet betekent (voorbeelden):

* bij Alliander werk je mee aan een dataplatform dat helpt bij het slim beheren van energienetwerken. Dit zorgt ervoor dat piekbelasting beter wordt voorspeld en energie slimmer wordt verdeeld
* bij Simon Loos draag je bij aan oplossingen die logistieke processen optimaliseren en daarmee de CO₂\-uitstoot helpen verlagen
* bij Hutten werk je mee aan een slimme verspillingsmonitor die realtime inzicht geeft in voorraadbeheer en helpt voedselverspilling te verminderen


Met Python, SQL en verschillende cloud\- en datatechnologieën leer je dataplatforms, ETL\-pipelines en data\-oplossingen bouwen die direct bijdragen aan duurzaamheid, kostenbesparing en procesoptimalisatie.


Je hoeft dit nog niet allemaal te kunnen. Juist als je nieuwsgierig bent en graag wilt leren, helpen wij je om je kennis en vaardigheden verder uit te bouwen.

**Jouw team**
-------------


Je bent onderdeel van onze Data Solutions\-cel, waar je samenwerkt met 40 data engineers, data scientists, BI\-specialisten en cloud\-architecten. Wij bouwen samen slimme, schaalbare data\-oplossingen en zetten data om in concrete impact voor toonaangevende bedrijven.


Als junior werk je nauw samen met ervaren collega's. Je krijgt begeleiding waar nodig, maar ook de ruimte om steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te pakken. Zo ontwikkel je jezelf niet alleen technisch, maar leer je ook hoe je data\-oplossingen bouwt die aansluiten bij de vraag van de klant.

**Wie jij bent**
----------------


Ervaring is voor ons minder belangrijk dan jouw sterke ambitie om Data Engineer te worden. Je hoeft dan ook zeker niet aan alle onderstaande punten te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat jij wilt leren en waar je naartoe wilt.


Je herkent jezelf in de bovengenoemde kernwaarden. Daarnaast heb je:

* een afgeronde hbo\- of wo\-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld Data Science, Computer Science, Informatica, Technische Informatica, Wiskunde of een vergelijkbare richting
* basiskennis van Python en/of SQL
* interesse in data engineering en cloudtechnologie
* een analytische en nieuwsgierige houding: je wilt begrijpen hoe dingen werken en bent niet bang om vragen te stellen
* de ambitie om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige Data Engineer en consultant
* je spreekt (vloeiend) Nederlands en Engels


Ben je net afgestudeerd of heb je al wat ervaring opgedaan met data? Beide zijn welkom. Misschien heb je tijdens je studie al projecten gedaan met Python, SQL, data pipelines, cloud of machine learning. Of misschien heb je jezelf buiten je opleiding verder verdiept in data. We kijken vooral naar jouw potentieel.


Dit is een pré, maar geen vereiste!

* ervaring met Snowflake en DBT
* kennis van Spark, Airflow of Kubernetes
* ervaring met een cloudplatform zoals AWS, GCP of Azure
* ervaring met Git en CI/CD
* ervaring met data\-analyse, ETL of datamodellering
* persoonlijke projecten op het gebied van data

 **Daarnaast herken je je in onze CBAM\-waarden:**


Camaraderie \- We zijn meer dan collega’s: we inspireren, ondersteunen en vieren successen samen


Boldness \- We durven te experimenteren én kritisch mee te denken voor echte impact


Autonomy \- Jij krijgt het vertrouwen en de ruimte om je werk zelf vorm te geven


Mastery \- We blijven leren en groeien, met een persoonlijk ontwikkelpad en volop kennisdeling


Twijfel je of je helemaal past? We leren je graag kennen, juist als je nog aan het begin van je carrière staat.

**We bieden jou:**
------------------

* Een maandsalaris (obv. 40 uur) tussen de € 3\.000,\- en € 3\.800,\-
* Een vast contract na je proeftijd
* met de mogelijkheid om 32\-40 uur per week te werken
* Een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, zónder studieschuld
* Een elektrische leaseauto naar keuze of lease niet vergoeding \+ km\-vergoeding
* Een NS\-Business Card voor je zakelijke reizen (én privéreizen als je geen leaseauto hebt)
* 27 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 10 bij te kopen
* Een premievrij pensioen
* Elke 4 jaar €2\.250 budget om je eigen laptop te kiezen
* Elke 3 jaar een vergoeding voor het inrichten van een thuiswerkplek
* De mogelijkheid om certificaathouder te worden (samen met 150\+ collega’s mede\-eigenaar van Incentro)
* Mastery Money: in januari €650 om jouw potentieel te ontketenen: van een cursus Spaans tot nieuwe hardloopschoenen
* Maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding
* Een team met serieuze aandacht voor diversiteit \& inclusiviteit, en ondersteuning voor je fysieke én mentale gezondheid


Daarnaast organiseren we borrels, feestjes en meerdaagse “even\-met\-elkaar\-weg”\-trips en om het jaar gaan we samen op Wincentrosport. Meer weten over onze secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden? Kijk in ons handboek!

**Interesse?**
--------------


Wil je meer weten over werken bij Incentro of het sollicitatieproces? Bel of stuur een bericht naar onze recruiter, Dexter van der Swaluw, op 06 17 44 91 98\. Hij helpt je dan graag verder.


Solliciteer nu en bouw mee aan slimme, schaalbare data\-oplossingen.

 **Eerst een keer laagdrempelig(er) kennismaken?**


Vind je de stap naar de sollicitatietafel nog te groot, maar hoor je wel graag vrijblijvend meer over werken bij Incentro van een van onze consultants? Kom dan ook in contact met onze recruiter Dexter. Hij plant dan graag een korte online kennismaking in van 30 minuten met een van onze collega's.

title: Principal Controls and Software Engineer
description:
#### **Shape the Future of Regenerative Medicine Manufacturing**


At Xeltis, we are pioneering transformative medical technologies that enable the body's natural healing processes to create living and durable vascular implants. As we transition from technology development into clinical and commercial\-scale manufacturing, we are looking for an experienced **Principal Controls \& Software Engineer.**

#### **The Role**


As Principal Controls \& Software Engineer, you will lead the architecture, development and implementation of our advanced control systems and embedded and software applications. You will bring strong knowledge of Computerised System Validation (CSV) and of software verification and validation (V\&V).


This is a unique opportunity for an experienced Controls \& Software Engineer to take ownership of ensuring that our manufacturing/ Shopfloor Control processes are scalable, compliant, reliable, and ready to support global commercialization. The scope also includes our business applications \& data architecture such as; SCM, logistics and our azure (middleware) platform.


Working with our Business leaders across e.g., Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, R\&D and External partners, you will ensure that Xeltis' control systems business applications \& data architecture, meet the highest standards of performance, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Advanced control systems and embedded/software applications;**

* Lead the design and development of control algorithms and software architectures.
* Develop and maintain embedded software, real\-time control systems, and automation applications.
* Define system requirements, specifications, and technical standards.
* Perform system modelling, simulation, testing, and validation.
* Integrate hardware, software, sensors, actuators, and communication protocols.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex system and software issues.
* Conduct design reviews and ensure compliance with industry standards and safety regulations.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering teams.
* Collaborate with product management, hardware engineers, manufacturing teams, and customers.
* Drive continuous improvement, innovation, and technology roadmaps.
* Support project planning, risk assessment, and resource estimation.
* Document designs, test procedures, and engineering solutions.

#### **Automation Strategy \& Architecture**

* Define and govern the long\-term automation and control systems roadmap across manufacturing operations.
* Develop scalable, modular, and standardised control system architectures across equipment and facilities.
* Drive harmonisation of software platforms, coding standards, and automation best practices.
* Ensure automation solutions support future product and manufacturing expansion.
* Serve as the Design Authority for automation, controls, software and manufacturing systems within Engineering \& Manufacturing, approving architectural decisions and technical standards, and advising on enterprise technology selection together with IT and the relevant function owners.

#### **Software Compliance (CSV) \& Regulatory Leadership**

* Act as the company's subject matter expert for GMP, GAMP, NIS2, software validation, data integrity, and electronic records compliance.
* Ensure control systems, manufacturing software, other business software meet medical device and regulatory requirements.
* Lead validation activities and support regulatory inspections and audits.

#### **Manufacturing Scale\-Up \& Technology Transfer**

* Lead the translation of laboratory and R\&D processes into robust, automated manufacturing systems.
* Drive software automation strategies that improve process reproducibility, product consistency, and manufacturing efficiency.
* Support technology transfer activities from development to commercial production environments.

#### **Digitalisation \& Advanced Process Control**

* Identify and implement advanced control strategies to optimise manufacturing performance.
* Drive integration of process analytical technologies (PAT), and our application architecture e.g., manufacturing execution systems (MES), and data management platforms.
* Champion digital transformation initiatives that enhance operational insight and process understanding.
* Develop the long\-term Industry 4\.0 roadmap covering cloud integration, advanced analytics and AI\-enabled process optimisation.

#### **Reliability \& Operational Excellence**

* Establish standards for automation system reliability, cybersecurity, maintenance, and lifecycle management.
* Define and govern OT cybersecurity architecture in accordance with IEC 62443 and corporate cybersecurity policies.
* Develop strategies to maximise equipment uptime and minimise operational risk.
* Lead root cause investigations and continuous improvement efforts relating to automation systems.

#### **Technical Leadership \& Mentoring**

* Provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary engineering projects.
* Serve as the primary controls and software technical interface between Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and external vendors.

#### **Vendor \& Systems Integration Management**

* Define automation specifications and standards for equipment suppliers and systems integrators.
* Ensure third\-party systems integrate seamlessly with Xeltis infrastructure and long\-term automation strategy.
* Oversee vendor performance throughout system design, implementation, and commissioning.

#### **Essential Qualifications \& Experience**

* Master's degree or PhD in Automation Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in industrial automation, control systems, and manufacturing software within regulated industries.
* Strong knowledge of Siemens PLC’s, Ignition SCADA, HMI, and industrial control system architectures, programming and debugging.
* Demonstrated experience leading automation projects from concept through commissioning and validation.
* Deep understanding of GMP, GAMP5, CSV and data integrity requirements.
* Experience supporting manufacturing scale\-up, technology transfer, and process automation initiatives.
* Proven ability to establish technical standards and influence engineering strategy across organisations.
* Experience managing external automation vendors and systems integrators.

#### **Technical Expertise**

* Control system architecture and design, PLC code development, debugging and Troubleshooting.
* Industrial networking and cybersecurity
* Manufacturing data management and system integration
* Advanced process control methodologies
* MES, historian, and industrial data platforms
* Software validation and lifecycle management
* Regulatory compliance in medical device, pharmaceutical, biotech, or related industries

#### **Soft Skills \& Leadership Attributes**

* Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long\-term vision and practical execution.
* Strong leadership and influencing skills across all organisational levels.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Strong communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
* Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Passionate about innovation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

#### **Why Join Xeltis?**


At Xeltis, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a technology that has the potential to transform patient outcomes globally. You will work alongside world\-class scientists, engineers, and manufacturing professionals in a collaborative and innovative environment where your expertise will directly influence the future of regenerative medical device manufacturing.


If you are excited by the challenge of building scalable, compliant, and cutting\-edge manufacturing automation systems in a rapidly growing MedTech company, we would love to hear from you.


Xeltis is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants and make employment decisions without regard to age, gender, ethnicity, nationality, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Apply now and help shape the future of regenerative medicine at Xeltis.**

title: Data Scientist
description:
#### **Functie\-informatie**


* Startdatum


05\-10\-2026
* Sluitingsdatum


07\-09\-2026
* Contractvorm


\-
* Aantal uur


36
* Functieniveau


Medior
* Contractduur


1 jaar

  
#### **Vacaturebeschrijving**


#### **Overzicht**


Als Data Scientist speel je een cruciale rol in het ondersteunen en optimaliseren van Rabobank's Transaction Monitoring\-mogelijkheden. Door middel van geavanceerde analyses, dashboardontwikkeling en samenwerking met stakeholders help je collega's om datagedreven beslissingen te nemen die de effectiviteit van het detecteren van mogelijke witwas\- en terrorismefinancieringsactiviteiten vergroten.


Je werk draagt direct bij aan het creëren van een veiliger financieel systeem, terwijl je meer efficiënte en effectieve Transaction Monitoring\-processen mogelijk maakt.


* Uitvoeren van end\-to\-end analytische projecten, van business intake en eisenverzameling tot codering, analyse, visualisatie en presentatie van resultaten.
* Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van impactvolle Power BI\-dashboards die Transaction Monitoring\-optimalisatie en besluitvorming ondersteunen.
* Ontwikkelen van schaalbare en onderhoudbare analytische oplossingen met Python.
* Het inschatten en beoordelen van de impact van voorgestelde wijzigingen in Transaction Monitoring\-regels en parameters.
* Complexe bedrijfsvragen vertalen naar analytische benaderingen en uitvoerbare aanbevelingen.
* Optreden als een vertrouwde partner voor stakeholders, hen helpen de juiste vragen te formuleren en kansen te ontdekken via data.
* Continu verbeteren en proactief gebieden identificeren waar analyses meetbare bedrijfswaarde kunnen creëren.
* Nauw samenwerken met dataprofessionals, bedrijfsexperts en andere stakeholders in multidisciplinaire teams.

#### **Eisen**


* Master's degree in een kwantitatief of technisch veld.
* Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring als Data Scientist, Data Analyst of vergelijkbare analytische rol.
* Sterke Power BI\-expertise, inclusief geavanceerde dashboardontwikkeling, datavisualisatie en storytelling met data.
* Solide Python\-programmeer vaardigheden, inclusief Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), software engineering best practices, coding standards en code reviews, en het schrijven van onderhoudbare en schaalbare code.
* Aantoonbaar vermogen om zelfstandig initiatieven te leiden en resultaten te behalen.
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden met het vermogen om bedrijfsbehoeften te vertalen naar analytische oplossingen.
* Gestructureerde, proactieve en zeer georganiseerde werkstijl.
* Sterke stakeholder management en samenwerkingsvaardigheden.
* Bedrijfsgerichte mindset met een sterk gevoel van eigenaarschap.
* Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden in het Engels.

#### **Wensen**


* Ervaring met werken in een Financial Economic Crime (FEC), AML, Transaction Monitoring, Risk of Compliance omgeving.
* Vermogen om technische diepgang te balanceren met bedrijfsimpact.
* Comfortabel opereren in een dynamische, snel veranderende omgeving.
* Gemotiveerd door het leveren van meetbare verbeteringen in plaats van het bouwen van analytische oplossingen omwille van zichzelf.
  

  

#### **Competenties**


* Resultaatgericht
  
  

#### **Aanvullende details**


* Hybride werken \- Kantoordagen: maandag en donderdag (tijdelijke locatie Winthontlaan 1 Utrecht tot 31 januari 2027\).
* Tijdelijke locatie tot ten minste 31 januari 2027: Winthontlaan 1, Utrecht.
* Locatie na verbouwing: Croeselaan 18, Utrecht.
* Duur: 1 jaar (verlenging van de opdracht is mogelijk).
* Hybrid working \- Office days: Monday and Thursday (Temporary location Winthontlaan 1 Utrecht until January 31th 2027\)

  
#### **Skills**


Power BI Python Object\-Oriented Programming Data Visualization Stakeholder Management Monitoring

title: Vacature: AI Engineer - View vacancy
description:
Ready to make AI work beyond the proof of concept? At ABN AMRO Verzekeringen, your next AI engineering challenge combines the opportunities of both banking and insurance. You get the best of both worlds: the entrepreneurial character of AAV, the scale and expertise of NN, and a broad range of real\-life challenges where AI can make a difference.


This is an exciting time to join. AI engineering is growing, our organisation is evolving and we are exploring how new technology can help us serve customers and colleagues in smarter ways. That means there is room to experiment, take initiative and influence how we work. You will join a diverse network of specialists, contribute your own ideas and help us move from exploring what AI could do to showing what it can do.


**What you are going to do**


In this role, you design, build and improve AI solutions that are reliable, maintainable and ready to use. You work with data scientists, engineers, product owners, platform teams and business colleagues to translate real problems into practical solutions, and you help make sure AI can be adopted responsibly within AAV and NN.


Key responsibilities include:


* Translate business, user or organisational needs into practical AI solutions with a clear technical design, expected value and success criteria
* Design, develop and maintain AI applications, APIs, services and reusable components using Python, cloud services and relevant AI techniques
* Work on generative AI, LLM\-based, RAG, document intelligence, agentic or decision\-support solutions
* Bring AI solutions from prototype to production\-ready setups by applying CI/CD, automated testing, deployment pipelines, monitoring, logging, documentation and secure development practices
* Contribute to reusable standards, templates, components or platform capabilities that help teams apply AI more effectively and consistently
* Stay up to date with relevant AI engineering developments and assess which techniques are useful, realistic and responsible for NN

**What we offer you**
  

NN invests in an inclusive, inspiring work environment and in skills and competences for the future. We match this with employee benefits that are in line with what is needed today and in the future. This way, we offer our employees the opportunity to get the best out of themselves. We offer you:


* Salary between €5,933 and €7,910, based on 40 hours, depending on your knowledge and experience
* 13th month and holiday allowance are paid with your monthly salary
* 27 vacation days for a 5\-day working week and three Diversity Days
* A modern pension administered by BeFrank
* Plenty of training and learning opportunities
* NS Business Card 2nd class, which gives you unlimited travel, also privately.
  

Do you prefer to travel with your own transport? Then you can declare the kilometers travelled
* Allowances for setting up your home office and for internet use

**Who you are**


You have solid experience applying AI engineering or software engineering in a business environment. You are able to work independently on AI solutions, challenge assumptions and translate technical possibilities into practical solutions that create value.


* You have a completed master’s degree in a relevant field, such as computer science, artificial intelligence, data science or another quantitative discipline
* You have 3 or more years of experience in AI engineering, software engineering, ML engineering or a closely related role
* You are familiar with version control, cloud tooling, CI/CD, automated testing, release pipelines or software engineering principles and can apply them in day\-to\-day work
* You understand how to bring AI solutions from prototype to a more stable setup together with data scientists, data engineers, cloud engineers or platform teams
* You are able to explain technical concepts, choices and limitations clearly to both technical colleagues and business stakeholders
* You are comfortable working in an agile environment and can adapt your approach based on changing priorities or new insights

**Who you will work with**


We are currently reshaping the data organization within AAV because we want to leverage as much value from advanced analytics and AI as we can. In joining our team, you have the opportunity to help shape this future.


You will collaborate with colleagues from different specialisms, as well as with stakeholders across both the business and IT. Depending on the solution you are creating, you may work with people from AAV, NN, or both. That means you will build relationships with colleagues in different teams and locations across the Netherlands.


We work in a hybrid environment, with around two days a week in the office. We also organise Data Days and other activities for the wider data community. And because learning from mistakes is part of how we improve, we even celebrate them with our “borrelpot”.


Our team is diverse, friendly and open. Everyone has the space to be themselves. If you enjoy meeting colleagues outside work, Young AAV and NNYP organise social activities across the country. If you prefer to head home after a day at the office, that is equally understood. Speaking Dutch is a plus, but not a requirement.


You will also be an active member of the Data Science \& AI guild, a community of around 100 data scientists and AI Engineers across NN. Here, you contribute to knowledge sharing, define best practices, and collaborate on advancing AI standards across the organisation.


**Any questions?**


If you have any questions about the job, you can reach out to Liselotte van der Zeeuw – Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist Tech \& Data via Liselotte.van.der.zeeuw1@nn\-group.com.



Stel je vraag aan Liselotte van der Zeeuw
**Bij** **NN** **geloven we dat onze verschillen ons sterker maken.**


We verwelkomen talent in alle vormen en waarderen de unieke ervaringen, achtergronden, perspectieven en kwaliteiten die iedereen meebrengt. Daarom bouwen we aan een inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich welkom, gewaardeerd en vrij voelt om zichzelf te zijn.


Twijfel je of je aan alle functie\-eisen voldoet? Laat dat je niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We zijn niet alleen geïnteresseerd in je ervaring, maar ook in je motivatie, je potentieel en de impact die je wilt maken.


**Be yourself. You belong at NN.**


**Ben je net zo enthousiast?**
------------------------------


Je wordt doorgestuurd naar NN's recruitment systeem, Workday, waar je kunt solliciteren en jouw sollicitatie kunt beheren.



**Kan ik je ergens mee helpen?**
--------------------------------


### **Liselotte van der Zeeuw**


Recruiter


Send email to Liselotte van der Zeeuw


**Wat gebeurt er na je sollicitatie?**
--------------------------------------


**1** **Je solliciteert**
-------------------------


Jouw CV en motivatie worden door de Talent Acquisition Specialist en manager bekeken. Je ontvangt een reactie binnen twee weken.


**2** **Interview(s) en online assessment**
-------------------------------------------


We streven ernaar binnen een week het eerste gesprek in te plannen. Voorafgaand aan je tweede gesprek vragen we je een online assessment te maken.


**3** **Aanbod**
----------------


Zijn we een match? Dan ontvang je van ons direct een aanbieding. De Talent Acquisition Specialist loopt samen met jou het aanbod door.


**4** **Welkom bij NN**
-----------------------


Aanbieding geaccepteerd? Gefeliciteerd! Om alles ook administratief goed te regelen starten we de pre\-employment screening en sturen we jouw arbeidsovereenkomst toe.

title: Informatieanalist
description:
**3 redenen waarom dit jouw baan is**
-------------------------------------

* Werk met data die ertoe doet en draag bij aan een datagedreven SVB
* Vraag kritisch door om echt tot de kern te komen van wat een oplossing moet bieden om de stakeholder te helpen.
* Versterk het Service Center Data (SCD) op ons hoofdkantoor in Amstelveen.

**Jij doet het**
----------------


Als Informatieanalist bij het Service Center Data (SCD) ben je de verbindende schakel tussen de stakeholders van een directie en je eigen agile scrumteam. Je brengt informatiebehoeften scherp in beeld, adviseert over oplossingen en vertaalt deze naar realiseerbare dataoplossingen binnen het Azure\-dataplatform. Je helpt onze directie Dienstverlening Sociale Verzekeringen, die zich bezighoudt met onder andere AOW en Kinderbijslag, om de juiste inzichten te verkrijgen zodat zij betere beslissingen kunnen nemen.


Door goed te **luisteren** en **door te vragen**, help je stakeholders hun informatiebehoefte scherper te krijgen *(de vraag achter de vraag)* en stel je requirements op. Samen met collega’s in verschillende rollen werk je aan de ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van informatieproducten, met name op het gebied van analytics, rapportages en dashboards. Je stuurt op herbruikbaarheid, privacy, datakwaliteit en tijdigheid en draagt actief bij aan de ambitie van de SVB om datagedreven te werken.

**Concreet, wat zijn jouw taken als Informatieanalist?**

* **Onderzoek** welke inzichten nodig zijn; definieer meetwaarden (feiten) en invalshoeken (dimensies) en vertaal deze naar dataproducten.
* **Bekijk** welke bestaande bronnen kunnen worden ingezet en stem af met gegevenseigenaren en procesverantwoordelijken.
* **Bepaal** de impact; maak inschattingen van de benodigde inspanning en afhankelijkheden en doe voorstellen voor tijdslijnen.
* **Werk** binnen het privacy\- en governancekader; zorg voor gegevensclassificatie en wees je bewust van de implicaties van het datagebruik.
* **Stel** conceptuele en logische datamodellen op die aansluiten op het bedrijfsgegevensmodel van de SVB. Stem deze af met architecten en ontwikkelteams binnen het medallion lakehouse:
	+ **Brons**: 1 op 1 van een bron inclusief historie.
	+ **Zilver**: bron\- en procesonafhankelijk relationeel model met historie.
	+ **Goud**: Dimensioneel model voor rapportages.
	+ **Model** voor datasets t.b.v. onderzoeksvragen.
* **Werk** op een kortcyclische manier (Agile Scrum) nauw samen met ontwikkelaars en product owners om de backlog scherp te krijgen.
* **Denk** inhoudelijk mee over functionele en acceptatietests, voer checks uit en bepaal mede wat getest moet worden. De testcoördinator is verantwoordelijk voor de planning en uitvoering.

 **"Samen maken we van data onze grootste kracht \- doe je mee?" Tom en Chantal zoeken een collega die deze ambitie met hen deelt.**

**Jij bent het**
----------------


In de eerste plaats ben jij jezelf. Daarvoor geven we jou binnen SVB alle ruimte. Je bent iemand die **onafhankelijk en zelfstandig** kan werken, zonder daarbij de **samenwerking** uit het oog te verliezen. Je bent **analytisch** en **gestructureerd** en weet abstracte vraagstukken te vertalen naar tastbare oplossingen. Je neemt je stakeholders binnen de directie mee in je denkrichting en houdt je collega’s (scrum master, product owner, data engineers en report engineers) periodiek op de hoogte tijdens de reguliere Agile Scrum\-events.

**Dit breng je mee:**

* Academisch werk\- en denkniveau.
* Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als informatie\- of businessanalist in een complexe dataomgeving.
* Ervaring met informatieanalyse en het opstellen van requirements. Een IREB\-certificering, of je bent bereid dit te volgen.
* Kennis van én ervaring met het toepassen van SQL voor gestructureerde data (tabellen, kolommen en relaties) en Python of R voor ongestructureerde data.
* Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. *(Full proficiency in Dutch is a formal requirement for this position.)*

**Dit is mooi meegenomen**

* Kennis van datamodellering (relationeel, dimensioneel) en BI\-architectuurprincipes.

**Welke kansen bieden we jou?**
-------------------------------


Jouw uitdaging, balans en groei: het heeft onze aandacht. Kansen en mogelijkheden om te groeien als persoon en als professional zijn er genoeg. Aan jou de taak om ze te pakken. Ook kan jij bij start als Informatie Analist (op basis van een 36\-urige werkweek) rekenen op:

* elke maand maximaal € 6\.395,00 brutosalaris (fulltime is bij de SVB 36 uur per week).
* 16,33% individueel keuzebudget. Jij kiest zelf hoe je dit inzet: wil je bijvoorbeeld meer salaris, een sabbatical, meer pensioen opbouwen of meer verlofdagen? Aan jou de keuze.
* ruim 5 weken vakantie per jaar.


Er is nog meer. Ga voor een compleet overzicht naar http://www.werkenbijdesvb.nl/vacatures/arbeidsvoorwaarden.

**Jouw werkomgeving**
---------------------


Van kinderbijslag tot AOW\-pensioen: namens de overheid en samen met 4\.500 collega’s maken we het mogelijk om de volksverzekeringen uit te betalen. Dat betekent dat we elk jaar 62 miljard euro overmaken aan zo’n 5,7 miljoen mensen. Op tijd, eerlijk en efficiënt.  

  

Welkom bij de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) en meer specifiek bij de directie Bedrijfsvoering. Binnen de afdeling Service Center Data werk je in een domeinteam en vakgroep waar inhoud, samenwerking en kwaliteit centraal staan. Je krijgt ruimte om je vakmanschap verder te ontwikkelen, mee te denken over standaarden en actief bij te dragen aan hoe informatieanalyse binnen de SVB wordt vormgegeven. We leren van elkaar, sparren inhoudelijk en bouwen samen aan herbruikbare en toekomstbestendige dataoplossingen. Bij het SCD werkt Willem al als Data Scientist. Benieuwd hoe hij het werken bij ons ervaart?

*"Ons vakgebied wordt de komende jaren steeds volwassener. Ik dacht een paar jaar geleden nog dat vereenvoudiging van het gereedschap het voor iedereen eenvoudiger zou maken om data\-onderzoek te doen. Dat klopt in de praktijk, maar het levert veel slecht onderzoek op. Aan ons als experts om kwaliteit te leveren.*

*Als team proberen we continu te verbeteren en onszelf en elkaar scherp te houden. Daarnaast houden we de ontwikkelingen in de gaten. Ik hou van nieuwe dingen, dus daar sta ik zeker voor open. Zo groei ik mee in het vak en groeien we ook als team."*


We werken met elkaar samen en ontmoeten elkaar op kantoor. Daarnaast is het in overleg met je team en leidinggevende ook mogelijk deels thuis te werken. Jouw standplaats is Amstelveen.

title: Postdoc Solvothermal Recycling of Cardiac Catheters
description:
Postdoc Solvothermal Recycling of Cardiac Catheters
Shape the future of biomaterials from waste!
Job description
We have a new Postdoc vacancy in our group on solvothermal recycling of cardiac catheters. This Postdoc position is part of the newly funded Top Sector Life Sciences \& Health (LSH) project \- EvalueWaste.
This project brings together a multidisciplinary consortium from industry and academia to tackle one of the most pressing challenges of the healthcare sector: single\-use cardiac electro\-surgical catheters. Every year, about 170,000 electro\-surgical instruments and cardiac electro\-surgical catheters are discarded, along with 70,000 kg of plastic handles. These single\-use devices are often made of complex, highly engineered composite materials with various types of polymers and precious metals that are difficult to recycle. Thus, after used, cardiac catheters are usually incinerated, resulting in significant material losses and environmental impact
As a Postdoc within the EvalueWaste consortium at TU Delft, you will:
• Scale\-up of a solvothermal process to recover metals and polymers from cardiac catheters for reuse.
• Publish high\-quality scientific articles in peer\-reviewed journals and contribute to project reports in collaboration with the project supervisors and others.
• Participate in consortium meetings, workshops, and stakeholder events, and actively contribute to knowledge exchange and impact activities.
• Support the supervision of students where relevant and contribute to the academic life of the department.
This Postdoc position provides a unique opportunity to help redefine the circularity in the healthcare sector in collaboration with the leading industry and the unique GreenCycl initiative.
Job requirements
You are strong in advanced chemical engineering research and enjoy hands\-on experimental work. You are eager to grow your expertise and enjoy engaging with and supporting students. You need to have:
A PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
Experience in experimental study of mechanical processing
Hands on experince in practical engineering and process design
A critical attitude towards results is expected, which translates into formulating new research questions.
Ability to function both in a team and independently.
Good communication skills. good in English, both spoken and written.
TU Delft (Delft University of Technology)
Working at TU Delft means contributing to solutions that really make a difference.
For over 180 years, we have been training engineers who make an impact worldwide in companies, government bodies, or as entrepreneurs. Our alumni turn knowledge into concrete solutions for the challenges of today and tomorrow.
These challenges are changing rapidly. That is why we focus on themes such as energy, climate, digitalisation, artificial intelligence (AI), and smart mobility every day. Our education and research are directly aligned with what society needs now and in the future.
At TU Delft, our people make the difference. With their knowledge and curiosity, our staff provide a high\-quality education and conduct pioneering research that extends beyond the campus. You will have the opportunity to take the initiative, work with others, and grow as a professional.
Working at TU Delft means join an international community of professionals and students. Together, we create knowledge, innovations, and solutions that help move the world forward.
Faculty Mechanical Engineering
From chip to ship. From machine to human being. From idea to solution. Driven by a deep\-rooted desire to understand our environment and discover its underlying mechanisms, research and education at the ME faculty focusses on fundamental understanding, design, production including application and product improvement, materials, processes and (mechanical) systems.
ME is a dynamic and innovative faculty with high\-tech lab facilities and international reach. It’s a large faculty but also versatile, so we can often make unique connections by combining different disciplines. This is reflected in ME’s outstanding, state\-of\-the\-art education, which trains students to become responsible and socially engaged engineers and scientists. We translate our knowledge and insights into solutions to societal issues, contributing to a sustainable society and to the development of prosperity and well\-being. That is what unites us in pioneering research, inspiring education and (inter)national cooperation.
. Do you want to experience working at our faculty? These videos will introduce you to some of our researchers and their work.
Conditions of employment
Duration of contract is 1 years. Temporary external finance.
A job of 36\-40 hours per week.
Salary and benefits are in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for Dutch Universities.
An excellent pension scheme via the ABP.
The possibility to compile an individual employment package every year.
Discount with health insurers on supplemental packages.
Flexible working week.
Every year, 232 leave hours (at 38 hours). You can also sell or buy additional leave hours via the individual choice budget.
Plenty of opportunities for education, training and courses.
Partially paid parental leave
Attention for working healthy and energetically with the vitality program.
Will you need to relocate to the Netherlands for this job? TU Delft is committed to make your move as smooth as possible! The HR unit, Coming to Delft Service, offers information on their website to help you prepare your relocation. In addition, Coming to Delft Service organises events to help you settle in the Netherlands, and expand your (social) network in Delft. A Dual Career Programme is available, to support your accompanying partner with their job search in the Netherlands. .
Additional information
For more information about this vacancy, please contact Dr.ir.Tim Horeman\-Franse, t.horeman@tudelft.nl.
For more information about the research group of Dr.ir. Luis Cutz, please visit: Tim Horeman\-Franse \| LinkedIn and www.tudelft.nl/staff/t.horeman/.
For more information about the department, please visit: https://www.tudelft.nl/me/over/afdelingen/process\-energy.
Application procedure
Are you interested in this vacancy? Please apply no later than 1 October 2026 upload the following documents:
CV
Motivational letter
If the applicants are selected for an interview, they will be asked to provide contact details of at least two referees with their consent
You can address your application to Dr.ir.Tim Horeman\-Franse.
Please note:
You can apply online. We will not process applications sent by email and/or post.
As part of knowledge security, TU Delft conducts a risk assessment during the recruitment of personnel. We do this, among other things, to prevent the unwanted transfer of sensitive knowledge and technology. The assessment is based on information provided by the candidates themselves, such as their motivation letter and CV, and takes place at the final stages of the selection process. When the outcome of the assessment is negative, the candidate will be informed. The processing of personal data in the context of the risk assessment is carried out on the legal basis of the GDPR: performing a public task in the public interest. You can find more information about this assessment on our website about knowledge security.
Please do not contact us for unsolicited services.
  
Faculty/Department: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering
Salary range: €3706 \- €5760

title: Data Science - IC - F
description:
Role Description:
**Job Title**: Data Scientist II

**Team Location**: Amsterdam, the Netherlands

 **About Us:** At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

 **Role Overview**


The Data Scientist II will own and deliver end\-to\-end data science solutions supporting Payments and Accounting. The role partners closely with business and technical stakeholders to define complex business problems, translate them into analytical and modelling approaches, and deliver intelligent analytics and actionable insights. They will independently apply statistical \& predictive analytics, and emerging GenAI techniques to develop innovative data\-driven solutions across Accounting processes and use cases. The role will also explore and apply GenAI capabilities to enhance how Accounting data is analyzed, interpreted, and translated into insights and scalable business solutions.

 **Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Own end\-to\-end data science solutions, from problem framing and experimental design through analysis, recommendation, implementation and impact measurement.
* Design and execute statistically robust experiments to optimize collection interventions and maximize recovery while protecting partner experience.
* Analyze payout and collection journeys to identify opportunities that help O2C pay partners successfully and collect receivables effectively.
* Translate ambiguous business challenges into clear hypotheses, analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
* Partner with O2C operations, product, Finance, FinTech, data and engineering teams, and communicate results clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Build scalable and reproducible solutions and ensure quality through validation and peer review.
* Measure impact through collection and recovery performance, payout outcomes, write\-off, partner experience and adoption, while supporting junior colleagues.

 **Role Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Experience applying GenAI methods and building production\-scale agents to develop intelligent analytics and data\-driven solutions for complex business problems; domain experience in finance or fintech is preferred.


Proven experience applying data science to complex business problems and delivering measurable outcomes.

* Strong knowledge of experimental design, A/B testing, statistical inference and quantitative decision\-making.
* Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or R, with experience preparing and modelling large datasets.
* Familiarity with modern data platforms and workflows such as Snowflake, Spark, dbt, ETL and data\-quality practices.
* Strong stakeholder management, data visualization and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence decisions.
* Experience in finance, payments, collections, operational optimization or mentoring junior colleagues is desirable.

  

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique\-to\-Booking.com benefits which include:

* Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
* Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
* Industry leading product discounts \- up to 1400 per year \- for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit

 **Inclusion at Booking.com:**

  

Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

  

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

  

We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

 **Application Process:**

* Let’s go places together: How we Hire
* Detailed instructions on post\-application requirements including any required application materials, deadlines, portfolios, coding challenges, or other assessments as defined by BU or department.


Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive

title: Data Scientist Level 3
description:
Customer Insights and Analytics (CIA) is een data science\-team binnen het Cargo Digital Commercial Program. Het team levert dataprojecten en generatieve AI\-toepassingen die productinnovatie ondersteunen, waaronder personalisatie, klantprofilering en serviceautomatisering.

**Wat ga je doen?**
Als data scientist vertaal je zakelijke uitdagingen naar bruikbare inzichten en ontwikkel je AI\-proof\-of\-concepts. Met een open en groeigerichte mindset neem je end\-to\-end verantwoordelijkheid: je werkt samen met zakelijke stakeholders, verzamelt en bereidt data voor, ontwikkelt analytische oplossingen, onderhoudt en ondersteunt de producten waaraan je bijdraagt en presenteert inzichten die nieuwe kansen creëren voor producten, functionaliteiten, verkoop en dienstverlening.

**Waar land je?**
Je komt terecht in een uitdagende en dynamische omgeving die volop kansen biedt voor professionele groei. Je werkt binnen een divers team en een innovatieve werkomgeving met een internationale dynamiek.


Door nauw samen te werken met businessgebruikers ben je uitstekend gepositioneerd om vertrouwen op te bouwen, je domeinkennis te verdiepen en oplossingen te leveren die daadwerkelijk impact maken. Tegelijkertijd blijf je verbonden met de bredere data science\-community van Air France\-KLM, wat jouw voortdurende ontwikkeling en professionele groei ondersteunt.

**Jouw profiel**
Wij zijn op zoek naar een gepassioneerde, ervaren en pragmatische data scientist: een nieuwsgierige bouwer die effectief communiceert en goed functioneert in een dynamische omgeving.

* Je bent een ervaren data scientist, maar je wordt vooral gedreven door het creëren van aantoonbare bedrijfswaarde, en minder door het bouwen van de meest geavanceerde of complexe oplossing.
* Je beschikt over een bachelor\- of masterdiploma in operations research, data science of informatica.
* Je bent vaardig in het selecteren van geschikte machine learning\-technieken en bent bekend met diverse ML\-methodologieën, toolkits en programmeertalen, zoals Python.
* Je kunt valkuilen en vertekeningen (bias) in data herkennen en schakelt moeiteloos tussen snelle prototyping en robuuste softwareontwikkeling.
* Je kunt de zakelijke impact van dataprocessen kwantificeren en effectief prioriteiten stellen bij kritieke vraagstukken.
* Je kunt complexe modelleerconcepten helder uitleggen aan zowel technische collega's als niet\-technische stakeholders en bent in staat je bevindingen overtuigend te presenteren.
* Ervaring met het industrialiseren van machine learning\-oplossingen is een pré. Je werkt samen met IT, die de leiding neemt bij het in productie brengen van de oplossing
* Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen machine learning en zet je actief in voor voortdurende professionele ontwikkeling.
* Je beheerst de Engelse taal vloeiend.
* Kandidaten met minimaal twee jaar aantoonbare werkervaring op het gebied van machine learning en data science komen in aanmerking voor deze functie.




**Wat bieden wij*** Een uitdagende rol bij een uniek Nederlands bedrijf;
* Een brutosalaris tussen €4\.348,98 en €7\.287,48 bruto per maand;
* Volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en mooie doorgroeimogelijkheden;
* Een goede pensioenregeling en 8% vakantiegeld;
* Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%;
* 25 vakantiedagen en 5 extra vrije dagen;
* Fikse korting op vliegtickets (als je minimaal 6 maanden in dienst bent);
* Een duurzaam vervoersbeleid, met o.a. 100% gratis reizen naar het werk met het Openbaar Vervoer (binnen Nederland);
* Korting op je ziektekostenverzekering;
* Een budget voor duurzame inzetbaarheid.




**Ready for your next destination?**
Wacht dan niet langer, en solliciteer voor de ‘final boarding call’ op 17\-09\-2026! Je hoeft geen motivatiebrief te schrijven; tijdens je online sollicitatie stellen we je enkele gerichte vragen. Je sollicitatieprocedure bestaat uit een gesprek en een case / assessment en een veiligheidsonderzoek. Binnen twee weken na sluitingsdatum van de vacature krijg je bericht van ons.Wist je dat volgens onderzoek vrouwen minder graag solliciteren dan mannen, als ze niet aan alle functie\-eisen voldoen? Zonde. Want ‘de perfecte kandidaat’ is wat ons betreft een fabeltje. Dus heb jij de drive om op enkele aspecten in deze rol nog te groeien? We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie.


Een referentiecheck kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure.

title: Medior Data Scientist
description:
At de Bijenkorf, data plays a central role in how we operate and make decisions, and we continue to expand our capabilities every day. With millions of customers visiting our stores and e\-commerce platform, we manage large and rapidly growing datasets that we use to train machine learning models and generate insights. These insights help us make smarter decisions and create impact across all areas of our business. From customer experience to logistics, assortment, and marketing. Want to help shape what’s next?
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Scientist, you translate the richness of our customer data into tangible impact across our website, app, online marketing channels, stores, customer service, supply chain, and buying teams. You have the opportunity to improve the shopping experience of millions of customers and build the data products that power better decisions across the entire organization. You will:
   

  

* Ideate and develop Build scalable machine learning products across various domains, working directly with colleagues to explore and shape data\-driven solutions.
* Deploy and own Take models from development to production, owning the full ML ops lifecycle in close collaboration with our tech teams.
* Experiment and iterate Continuously improve production models, MLOps flows, and contribute to the broader data platform.


 We currently have a number of models in production across different business domains. Examples include recommendation systems, sales and returns forecasting, customer segmentation and lifetime value prediction, and marketing budget optimization. In our latest work, we built a recommender system using a LLM and a multimodal model that combines text and image features, allowing us to create more meaningful recommendations. Our work is powered by a modern tech stack including Python, GCP, BigQuery, dbt, git, Argo Workflows, Docker, Kubernetes and Airflow.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will join a centralized Data \& Analytics team, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and tracking \& measurement experts. The team operates Agile, giving you substantial responsibility and the freedom to make impactful decisions from the start. You’ll be based at our Service Office, with flexible remote work options.
   

  

 The Data \& Analytics team supports a diverse range of organizational departments with their data needs, giving you the chance to work with a variety of data sources and use cases.
   

  

 Your Experience:
   

  

* Strong fundamental experience as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer (4\+ years of experience).
* Proficiency in Python for delivering production\-ready code.
* Proficiency in SQL, experience with dbt is a big plus.
* While hands\-on experience with GCP is a big plus, familiarity with a similar cloud platform is also valuable.


 Experience with other aspects of this role are great to have, but can also be learned on the job.
   

  

* Strong knowledge of CI/CD.
* Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with operationalizing machine learning models.


**Who you are:**
* Proactive and able to take ownership of projects end\-to\-end, from idea to production.
* You are able to identify opportunities where data and machine learning can have real business impact.
* You stay up\-to\-date with the latest industry trends and you are eager to implement your learnings.
* You are able to explain your solutions to a non\-technical audience
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.


 What we offer
   

  

* A gross monthly salary between €3,943 and €5,632 (based on 40 hours);
* 30 vacation days
* An annual profit sharing (variable) bonus
* Vitality budget
* Contribution towards your pension
* Hybrid environment
* A great culture
* An employee discount on products purchased from de Bijenkorf

title: Data Scientist
Medior Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**Join Allianz Direct!**
 The machine learning engineering chapter at Allianz Direct is a global team consisting of experienced data scientists / machine learning engineers that have been pioneering new use cases in insurance and building a modern machine learning platform. The team is responsible for the development, deployment, and maintenance of machine learning models in all 5 countries where Allianz Direct is currently active. We are looking for a medior data scientist / ML engineer to grow the team in Rotterdam, to build and deploy machine learning solutions end\-to\-end to serve business needs.
   

  

**You Will Get To**
* Work with experienced data scientists / ML engineers and focus on building one or two machine learning solutions at a time. Develop your models end\-to\-end, from ideation with business stakeholders to deployment and monitoring.
* Dive into a range of challenging modelling problems around our pricing engine, claim processes, customer contact center and operations. You can expect to tackle problems using classification, regression, anomaly detection, survival modelling, time series and large language models.
* Utilize our mature next generation data platform hosted on Databricks, containing well organized data across all Allianz Direct countries.
* Help to extend our machine learning platform used for development and deployment of a range of models, in both batch and API inference modes.
* Collaborate with dev engineers to embed a deployed model into company processes.
* Contribute to our continuously evolving way of working and internal packages, as well as benefit from and contribute to our weekly knowledge sharing sessions.
* Work on a modern tech stack. We use Python, Databricks, AzureML, MLflow and can leverage shared compute for large training jobs.
* Work together with diverse international colleagues based in Spain, Netherlands, Germany, Italy, and France.


**Your Profile**
* Located in the Netherlands, since this hybrid role requires working with the team at the office location in Rotterdam.
* Academic degree (MSc or PhD), preferably in a relevant technical field such as computer science, data science, physics, econometrics, or engineering.
* A strong foundation in machine learning fundamentals. You know how to properly apply a wide range of algorithms for classification, regression, and other predictive problems.
* At least 3 years of experience in a similar data science or ML engineering role.
* A love for coding. Programming experience in Python is required and you are familiar with libraries like pandas/scikit\-learn, and have experience doing hyper parameter tuning for a diverse set of models including boosting models.
* Experience with MLOps on Databricks or experience within the insurance business are a strong plus.
* You are a self\-learner. You are eager to keep developing and improving, and stay on top of the latest developments. You enjoy both sharing knowledge and learning from others.
* Fluent in English. Able to communicate complex topics in a clear and precise manner to audiences with different backgrounds and at different levels.


**What We Offer**
 At Allianz Direct you will find yourself in an inspiring working environment where there is plenty of room to set up your own initiatives, in an international scope. We believe that success starts with satisfied employees. That's why we offer you:
   

  

* An attractive monthly salary based on knowledge and experience, starting at €5200\.00 (based on full\-time employment of 38 hours).
* A bonus of 12\.5% of your gross annual salary and 8% holiday allowance.
* An NS business card which you can also use privately, or a travel allowance (€0\.23/km).
* Flexible working: 60/40 home/office, for which you will receive a home working allowance of up to €40\.00 per month.
* Vacation days: 25 for full\-time employment. You can get up to 38 vacation days per year for 40 hours per week.
* A pension plan with a small personal contribution of only 3\.5%.
* An annual contract with the intention of a permanent contract.
* A prime office location in the heart of Rotterdam, close to shops and restaurants.
* Festive moments are celebrated: an extensive end\-of\-year drinks party and a fun summer party.
* Discount on Allianz Direct insurance products.


 We invest in your personal and professional growth so that you can be successful in your work and beyond.
   

  

**About Us**
 Allianz Direct is Europe's leading digital insurer. We are building a fully data\-driven organization in which technology, automation, and customer experience are central. As ML engineer, you will play a key role in realizing that ambition. You will ensure that the available data is used intelligently to continuously improve our products, processes, and customer interactions.
   

  

 Curious about what we can offer you as ML engineer? Then we invite you to apply immediately!
   

  

 105539 \| IT \& Tech Engineering \| Professional \| Non\-Executive \| Allianz Direct \| Full Time or Part Time \| Temporary
   

  

 Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.
   

  

 At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.
   

  

 We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
   

  

 Great to have you on board
 **.** 
**Let's care for tomorrow.**

title: Data Scientist
description:
ShanX MedTech BV (SXMT, NL) is a dynamic company dedicated to revolutionizing healthcare through innovative diagnostic tools. Our journey began with a deeply personal experience; the founder's mother's near\-fatal struggle with a poorly treated bacterial infection. This ignited our mission to transform infection management, propelling us to develop pioneering solutions that prevent unnecessary suffering.
 


  


 At SXMT, impact is paramount. We're proud to introduce our groundbreaking rapid antibiotic susceptibility testing device, poised to redefine how bacterial infections are treated. Our goal is clear: to equip healthcare professionals with the means to make informed treatment decisions swiftly and accurately. Through our innovative solutions, we're combating antibiotic resistance, enhancing patient outcomes, and saving lives.
 


  


 As a (Data) Scientist at SXMT you will be responsible for the generation and development of new data analysis tools and algorithms. The role of the (Data) Scientist is pivotal in leveraging data\-driven approaches to inform and accelerate diagnostic product development, ultimately leading to improved patient outcomes and healthcare delivery.
 


  


 This is a full\-time contract for 40 hours per week, extending over three years.
 


  

 Tasks
   


 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
 


  


 Conducting R\&D: Contribution to the generation of relevant data that will be
 


  


 used as an input to (training of) algorithms.
 


  


 Data Analysis: Leading the analysis of large and complex datasets, including
 


  


 clinical data, and reference data generated from diagnostic assays. Applying
 


  


 statistical (e.g. PCA) and machine learning techniques to extract insights, identify
 


  


 patterns, and uncover relationships that inform diagnostic product development.
 


  


 Algorithm Development: Training, developing and refining algorithms and
 


  


 models for data analysis, interpretation, and predictive analytics. This may
 


  


 involve designing algorithms for diagnosis and more, risk prediction, or treatment
 


  


 response prediction to support diagnostic assay development but also
 


  


 implementation in application software.
 


  


 Feature Engineering: Identifying and engineering relevant features from raw data
 


  


 to enhance the performance and accuracy of (predictive) models. This includes
 


  


 preprocessing data, selecting informative features, and optimizing feature
 


  


 representations for improved model performance.
 


  


 Model Validation: Validating (predictive) models and algorithms using
 


  


 appropriate validation techniques, including cross\-validation, bootstrapping, and
 


  


 holdout validation. Assessing model performance metrics such as accuracy,
 


  


 sensitivity, specificity, and area under the curve (AUC) to evaluate predictive
 


  


 performance.
 


  


 Data Visualization: Creating clear and informative data visualizations, including
 


  


 plots, charts, and graphs, to communicate results and insights effectively to
 


  


 stakeholders. Visualizing complex data structures and relationships to facilitate
 


  


 understanding and decision\-making.
 


  


 Continuous Learning: Staying abreast of advances in data science methodologies,
 


  


 techniques, and tools relevant to in\-vitro diagnostics. Actively participating in
 


  


 professional development activities, such as training programs, conferences, and
 


  


 workshops, to enhance skills and knowledge.
 


  

 Requirements
   

  
* Required Qualifications
  


  


 • Master’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline.
 


  


 • 2 years’ experience in a similar function
 


  


 • Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in data science such as Python, R, or SQL. The ability to write efficient code for data manipulation, analysis, and modeling is necessary.
 


  


 • Familiarity with data management and preprocessing techniques, including data cleaning, transformation, and normalization.
 


  


 • Machine Learning: Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised learning, classification, regression, clustering, and dimensionality reduction.
 


  


 • Ability to create clear and informative data visualizations using tools like Matplotlib, Seaborn, or ggplot2\. Proficiency in conveying complex data insights through charts, graphs, and dashboards is important.
 


  


 • Fluency in English.
 


  


 • Openness to learn about performing experimental work in a laboratory environment and with bacteria.
 


  


 • Transferring algorithms and communication to professional application software developers. Maintain algorithm integrity/performance.
 


  

  
* Preferred Qualifications
  


  


 • Experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit\-learn or TensorFlow is beneficial.
 


  


 • Experience with handling large\-scale datasets and databases is advantageous.
 


  


 • Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with the fundamentals of in\-vitro diagnostics, including knowledge of biomarkers, assay technologies, and clinical applications. Understanding basic microbiology and medical terminology is advantageous.
 


  


 • Good communication skills to non\-technical stakeholders
 


  


 • A passion for working in a young company environment.
 


  

 Benefits
   


 • Competitive compensation and benefits package
 


  


 • Access to professional development opportunities for career growth and advancement, including training resources.
 


  


 • Flexible schedule and work arrangements
 


  


 • Dynamic and collaborative work environment

title: Data Scientist
description:
Ben jij een ervaren Data Scientist die energie haalt uit het verbeteren, versnellen en vereenvoudigen van diensten voor klanten én collega’s? Heb je een passie voor innovatie en wil je jouw expertise inzetten op een plek waar technologie en mensgerichtheid samenkomen? Dan is dit jouw kans.
   

  

 Voor onze business unit Schade en Inkomen zijn we op zoek naar een Data Scientist die het AI\-domein komt versterken. Je wordt onderdeel van het Business Optimalisatie binnen NN Schade \& Inkomen. Een team dat de verbinding zoekt met de business, werkt aan duurzame oplossingen en altijd streeft naar échte impact.
   

  

**Wat je gaat doen**
 Binnen het BO team van NN Schade \& Inkomen werk je aan uiteenlopende en betekenisvolle AI\-oplossingen, van voorspelmodellen tot het slim automatiseren van processen. Als data scientist ben jij degene die businessvraagstukken vertaalt naar krachtige Data \& AI oplossingen én de regie neemt om deze succesvol in productie te brengen.
   

  

 Met jouw technische expertise en scherpe blik help je het team vooruit: je ziet kansen, denkt mee over nieuwe toepassingen en versnelt de ontwikkeling van innovatieve oplossingen.
   

  

 Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:
   

  

 AI\-oplossingen bouwen
   

  

* Ontwikkel in implementeer zowel klassieke als Generative AI\-oplossingen met technieken zoals AI\-as\-a\-Service, Large Language Models (LLMs), Cognitive Services en OpenAI


 Continue verbetering
   

  

* Neem het voortouw bij het continu monitoren en verbeteren van modellen die in productie zijn, zodat ze blijvend waarde leveren


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Vanuit jouw inhoudelijke kennis rol schakel je met onze IT\-, architectuur en MLops collega’s. Zo zorg je dat we modellen efficiënt in productie brengen


 Ben jij iemand die energie krijgt van de nieuwste AI\-trends en het toepassen van technologie op echte businessvraagstukken? Dan is deze rol jou op het lijf geschreven.
   

  

**Wat wij jou bieden**
 NN investeert in een inclusieve, inspirerende werkomgeving en in vaardigheden en competenties voor de toekomst. Daarbij passen arbeidsvoorwaarden die aansluiten bij wat er vandaag nodig is én die rekening houden met de toekomst. Zo bieden we onze medewerkers de mogelijkheid het beste uit zichzelf te halen.
   

  

 Wij bieden jou:
   

  

* Salaris tussen € 4\.527 en € 6\.036 (o.b.v. 36 uur) en afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring
* 13de maand en vakantiegeld, maandelijks uitbetaald bij je salaris
* 27 vakantiedagen bij een werkweek van 5 dagen en drie Diversiteitsdagen
* Een moderne pensioenregeling uitgevoerd door BeFrank
* Volop training\- en opleidingsmogelijkheden
* NS Business Card 2e klas, waarmee je onbeperkt kunt reizen, ook privé. Reis je liever met eigen vervoer? Declareer dan je kilometers
* Thuiswerkvergoedingen voor internet en een goede werkplek


**Wat je meebrengt**
 Jij bent nieuwsgierig, innovatief en verbindend. Met jouw analytisch inzicht en creatieve aanpak los je complexe data\-uitdagingen effectief op. Je communiceert helder, denkt mee en stimuleert samenwerking binnen het team én met de business. Zo maak je data waardevol in de praktijk. Verder heb je:
   

  

* Een afgeronde wo\-opleiding met een master in in Computer Science, Econometrie, Wiskunde of een andere STEM\-gerelateerde studie/ minimaal 2 jaar ervaring opgedaan in het ontwikkelen van ML\-applicaties in Python
* Praktische kennis van het data science\-proces, zoals dataverzameling, opschoning, modelbeoordeling en modelimplementatie
* Evaring met het ontwikkelen van geautomatiseerde API’s en cloud\-oplossingen met behulp van (Azure) CI/CD\-tools, Git, Terraform
* De vaardigheden om relaties op te bouwen met een breed stakeholder veld, buiten het programma (operations medewerkers, proces experts etc.)
* Bewezen ervaring in het zelfstandig opzetten van complexe AI ‘end\-to\-end’ oplossingen die directe impact hebben geleverd
* Ervaring met het coachen van andere Data scientists op de inhoudelijke Data Science kennis
* Bij voorkeur ervaring met het ontwerpen van Generatieve AI oplossingen zoals LLMs etc. om zo o.b.v business requirements zelfstandig en proactief advies te kunnen geven hoe AI in te zetten op uitdagende business vraagstukken
* Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (C2\-level) is een vereiste


**Met wie je werkt**
 Je werkt dagelijks met een hecht team van data scientists, en een product owner die zorgt voor structuur en focus. Daarnaast werk je samen met de bredere Business Optimalisatie\-afdeling, waar expertise uit datam management en visualisatie, procesmanagement, riskmanagement en customer insights samenkomt.
   

  

 Je bent ook actief binnen het data science gilde: een community van zo’n 100 data scientists binnen NN. Hier deel je kennis, leer je van vakgenoten en versnel je je ontwikkeling. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze AI\-oplossingen maximale waarde leveren.
   

  

 Wat kenmerkt dit team:
   

  

 Een sterke inhoudelijke basis in zowel Generative AI als machine learning, een hands\-on mentaliteit, en een cultuur waarin verantwoordelijkheid, samenwerking en resultaatgerichtheid centraal staan.

 Voor vragen over de procedure kun je terecht bij Danitscha Vrolijk\-Mahadew, Talent Aqcuisition Specialist via danitscha.mahadew@nn.nl.
